role: PASCAL VOC 2012 Segmentation val image-presence evaluation of one immutable OpenAI-CLIP zero-shot score cache
scope_disclosure: This is a fixed external image-level presence evaluation of an already-computed score cache. It is not a segmentation mIoU result and does not establish general scientific evidence by itself.

target.name: image-level class presence
target.rule: For each immutable SegmentationClass PNG, class c is present iff any decoded mask pixel has VOC class ID c. Background 0 and void 255 are ignored.
target.label_access: Read only the direct <image_id>.png files under the configured SegmentationClass root. Do not access JPEGImages, Annotations, ImageSets/Main, class-specific files, or any other ground-truth source.

metric.name: uninterpolated integral average precision
metric.definition: Sort fixed continuous scores descending; aggregate equal scores as one threshold; AP is the sum of recall increments times precision at each distinct score. Macro mAP is the arithmetic mean across all 20 classes.
